what_happened: Research found the same false claim (empty/"no goals" from lean_goal treated as proof completion) restated in two additional surfaces beyond the dispatch's named gap: README.md:54 ("no goals" = done) and agents/lean-implementation-agent.md:753 ("Always verify proofs are actually complete (no goals)").
